correctness.rationale: The claim is finite and was reconstructed from first principles. Two independently constructed 32-vertex conflict graphs agree exactly; an include/exclude maximum-independent-set recurrence and an independent Bron–Kerbosch search on the complement both return maximum 20 and exactly one maximizer. A direct final check confirms read coverage 1 and the stated symmetries and weight profile.

value.rationale: The result answers the finite form of the literature’s fundamental codebook-size question at a natural smallest nontrivial parameter: binary length five with two distinct single-deletion reads. It supplies both the exact optimum and the full equality classification, providing a sharp benchmark for finite constructions and bounds. The uniqueness is structural information not supplied by the asymptotic redundancy results.
